# CHERMO
> CHERMO prepares personalized digital memory pages for customers in India. Choose a template, submit your story and photos, and share the published page by link. The free Memory Studio makes downloadable photo keepsakes.

Vansh Kashyap founded CHERMO in Delhi, India. Memory page templates are one-time purchases in INR. On 20 November 2026, the catalogue ranged from ₹19 to ₹399. Check the marketplace for the current price of a particular design.

## Main pages
- [Template marketplace](https://www.chermo.in/templates): Browse designs, preview templates and compare prices in INR.
- [Memory Studio](https://www.chermo.in/memory-studio/): Make a free Polaroid, photobooth strip or collage.
- [About CHERMO](https://www.chermo.in/about.html): Meet the founder and learn how a memory page is prepared.
- [Contact](https://www.chermo.in/contact.html): Email CHERMO about a template, an order or a published page.

## Occasion guides
- [Anniversary memory page](https://www.chermo.in/anniversary-memory-page): Pair photos across the years and write a dedication.
- [Proposal page](https://www.chermo.in/proposal-page): Choose photos and words for a personal proposal.
- [Birthday memory page](https://www.chermo.in/birthday-memory-page): Plan a birthday message and choose a design.
- [Best friend memory page](https://www.chermo.in/best-friend-memory-page): Turn shared moments into a friendship gift.
